Subject: Reminder! Join our Nov. 5 Public Meeting on the Larkspur Ferry Service Expansion & Parking Project Draft Environmental Impact Report
TextBody:
Dear Community Member,

The Golden Gate Bridge, Highway & Transportation District (District) invites you to a public meeting on the findings from the Draft Environmental Impact Report (DEIR) [ https://www.goldengate.org/district/district-projects/larkspur-ferry-service-parking-expansion-study/project-documents-materials/ ] for the Larkspur Ferry Service Expansion and Parking Project [ https://www.goldengate.org/district/district-projects/larkspur-ferry-service-parking-expansion-study/ ].

*Come to our Public Meeting! *

●        _When_: Thursday, November 5, 2026, 5:30-7:30 pm

●        _Where_: Larkspur Library, 10 Rose Lane, Larkspur, CA 94939 [ https://www.larkspur.ca.gov/716/About-Us ]

*Transportation & Accessibility Information*

●        Parking is available at Larkspur Library or Piper Park. For those traveling via public transit,  [ https://marintransit.gov/routes/22 ]Marin Transit Route 22 [ https://marintransit.gov/routes/22 ] stops at Magnolia Av & Ward St, which is a short walk to the meeting location.

●        Marin Transit [ http://www.marintransit.org/ ] operates specialized services for older adults, people with disabilities, and individuals with income barriers through Marin Access [ http://www.marinaccess.org/ ]. Travel Navigators are available to assist community members with information and enrollment by phone or email (M-F, 8am – 5pm). For more information, please call 415.454.0902 (select option 1 for Travel Navigators) or email travelnavigator@marinaccess.org.

*We invite you to comment and give your feedback on the DEIR, which will be released on October 19. *The deadline to comment is December 3, 2026. 

There are many ways to give your feedback:

●        *Join the November 5 Public Meeting at the Larkspur Library*

●        *Comment Online:* Larkspur Ferry Service Expansion and Parking Project Website [ https://www.goldengate.org/district/district-projects/larkspur-ferry-service-parking-expansion-study/ ]

●        *Email the Bridge District:* LFEP@goldengate.org

________________________________________________________________________


*Frequently Asked Questions*

Q: What is a Draft Environmental Impact Report (DEIR)?
A:  The Draft EIR evaluates potential environmental effects and invites public input before decisions are made on adopting the findings shown in the draft document.

Q: How do I comment on the DEIR?
A: There are many ways to comment! You can come to our November 5 public meeting to comment, go to the website [ https://www.goldengate.org/district/district-projects/larkspur-ferry-service-parking-expansion-study/ ], or email LFEP@goldengate.org. 

Q: Is this event wheelchair accessible? 
A:  This event is wheelchair accessible. 

Q: Can I bring my children? 
A:  This is a family friendly event, and children are welcome to attend. 

Q: Will there be Spanish translation or interpretation at the public meeting?
A:  Information will be provided in English and Spanish and there will be Spanish interpreters available at the event.

*Your feedback is valuable. *We encourage you to attend and share this invitation with friends, family, and colleagues who may be interested in this project. 

Sincerely,

*The Golden Gate Bridge, Highway and Transportation District*

—

*Project Background*

The Larkspur Ferry Service Expansion and Parking Study was undertaken as a means to meet increased future ferry demand as travel between Marin and San Francisco grows, along with congestion in the U.S. Highway 101 corridor. 

Future ferry ridership demand is based on the TAM Demand Model and indicates that when the Golden Gate Bridge reaches capacity, forecast to occur in the early 2040s, ferry service demand increases at a higher rate. Expanding ferry service will meet future demand for a reliable, climate-friendly transit option for Marin and Sonoma residents.  

The study analyzed a wide range of topics, including traffic and parking at Larkspur Landing, air quality, noise, lighting, ferry wake analysis, biological resources, and other topics. 

*Visit our website to learn more about the **Larkspur Ferry Service Expansion and Parking Study* [ https://www.goldengate.org/district/district-projects/larkspur-ferry-service-parking-expansion-study/ ]*. *
